name: Riccati Equation for Boundary Conditions
definition: A method to solve the two-point boundary value problem for radiance transport in vegetation by converting it into an initial value problem using a BRDF matrix F(z).
summary: The Riccati Equation for Boundary Conditions solves radiance transport in layered media by converting a two-point boundary value problem into an initial value problem via a non-linear differential equation for the reflection matrix.
